## The problem you have

You are about to commit to a completion programme. The basis of design
is written, the AFE is drafted, the equipment is on order. Internally,
everyone has signed off — but the people who signed off are the same
people who wrote it. You need an outside reviewer who has actually
delivered HPHT, deepwater, or sour-service wells, before the rig hits
the well.

## What you get

Three levels of scrutiny, depending on what the decision needs:

| Level | Deliverable | Turnaround |
|---|---|---|
| **Quick Look** | 60-minute scoping call + 1-page red-flag note covering 3–5 highest-risk issues | 5 working days |
| **Programme Review** | Full document review (BoD, well programme, risk register, materials selection) + 5-page memo with prioritised findings + 60-minute readout call | 10 working days |
| **Deep Dive** | Programme Review plus 1-day on-site / remote workshop with the well team, structured well-on-paper facilitation, post-workshop report | 30 days end-to-end |

: {tbl-colwidths="[20,60,20]"}

The Programme Review level is the most common entry point.

## What this is not

- A liability transfer. The well operator remains the duty-holder; my
  review is advisory.
- An equipment audit. I review design and operational thinking, not
  vendor certifications.
- A replacement for your internal HSE risk assessment.

## Process

1. **Initial call** — you explain the well, the timeline, and what you
   need an independent opinion on. I tell you which level fits.
2. **One-page scope note** — fixed scope, fixed deliverable, fixed
   turnaround, agreed before work starts.
3. **Delivery on the agreed turnaround.** You receive a clean memo or
   report; we run the readout call; you decide what to act on.

## Frequently asked

**Can you sign an NDA?**
Yes. Standard mutual NDA available, or I will sign yours after a quick
legal scan.

**Do you have professional indemnity insurance?**
Yes, held via Mattey Energy Ltd. Cover details on request.

**Will you take work that conflicts with your day role?**
No. I keep a strict conflict-of-interest framework and decline anything
that touches Basra Energy Company Limited's operational footprint or
BP / CNPC JV interests.

**Who owns the deliverable?**
You do. I retain the right to publish the *methodology* in anonymised
form (no client name, no well name, no figures); the underlying
documents and any client-specific findings remain confidential.
